name: poltergeist-browser-remote
description: Poltergeist Browser Remote: drive background browser tabs from macOS global hotkeys

scripts.build: dotenv -- sh -c 'mkdir -p dist && rm -rf dist/extension && cp -R src dist/extension && sed "s|__PGR_BRIDGE_PATH__|$PGR_BRIDGE_PATH|g" install/NativeMessagingHosts/poltergeist_bridge.json > dist/poltergeist_bridge.json && sed "s|__PGR_SOCKET_DIR__|$PGR_SOCKET_DIR|g" install/hammerspoon/init.lua > dist/init.lua && sed "s|__PGR_SOCKET_DIR__|$PGR_SOCKET_DIR|g" bin/poltergeist_bridge.py > dist/poltergeist_bridge.py && chmod +x dist/poltergeist_bridge.py'
scripts.build:bundle: npm run build && dotenv -- sh -c 'web-ext sign --source-dir dist/extension --channel unlisted --api-key $PGR_AMO_JWT_ISSUER --api-secret $PGR_AMO_JWT_SECRET'
scripts.provision: node scripts/ensure-env.cjs && npm run build && dotenv -- sh scripts/deploy.sh
scripts.watch: chokidar "src/**/*" "bin/**/*" "install/**/*" -c "npm run build && dotenv -- sh scripts/deploy.sh" --initial
